name: Nightrider Glaive
where: To get the Nightrider Glaive in Elden Ring, you need to defeat the Night's Cavalry boss who patrols the road in northern Liurnia of the Lakes.

name: Noble's Estoc
where: The Noble's Estoc is a rare drop obtained by defeating Wandering Nobles who wield the weapon, specifically those wearing feathered caps.

name: Noble's Slender Sword
where: The Noble's Slender Sword has a 0.5% drop rate and is exclusively farmed from specific Wandering Nobles that wield it.

name: Nox Flowing Hammer
where: To get the Nox Flowing Hammer, navigate to Nokron, Eternal City, start from the Ancestral Woods Site of Grace, and loot the weapon from a corpse on an upper ledge above two Nox Priests.

name: Nox Flowing Sword
where: The Nox Flowing Sword is dropped by defeating the Nox Swordstress & Nox Priest boss duo located inside Sellia, Town of Sorcery in Caelid.

name: Omen Cleaver
where: To get the standard Omen Cleaver, you need to farm the large Omen enemy wielding the curved greatsword in Stormveil Castle.

name: Onyx Lord's Greatsword
where: To get the Onyx Lord's Greatsword, head to the Sealed Tunnel in the Altus Plateau, navigate past hidden walls to the bottom of the cavern, and defeat the Onyx Lord boss.

name: Ordovis's Greatsword
where: To get Ordovis's Greatsword, you must defeat the duo boss Crucible Knight and Crucible Knight Ordovis at the end of the Auriza Hero's Grave on the Altus Plateau.

name: Ornamental Straight Sword
where: Drop from Grafted Scion (tutorial boss)

name: Parrying Dagger
where: The Parrying Dagger can be purchased from the NPC Patches for 1,600 runes.

name: Partisan
where: To get the Partisan spear in Elden Ring, you need to farm and defeat specific faction knights like the Godrick Knight at the Gatefront Ruins in Limgrave.

name: Pest's Glaive
where: To get the Pest's Glaive in Elden Ring, you must farm it from Lesser Kindred of Rot (Pest) enemies found in Caelid, the Grand Cloister, or Elphael.

name: Pickaxe
where: To get the Pickaxe in Elden Ring, travel to the Limgrave Tunnels (located north of Agheel Lake).

name: Pike
where: The Pike in Elden Ring is found on a corpse inside the main barricaded courtyard of Stormveil Castle.

name: Prelate's Inferno Crozier
where: To get the Prelate's Inferno Crozier in Elden Ring, you need to defeat the Fire Prelate wielding it inside Fort Laiedd in Mt. Gelmir.

name: Prince of Death's Staff
where: The Prince of Death's Staff is located in the Deeproot Depths area.

name: Pulley Bow
where: The Pulley Bow is located on a corpse at the top of a siege tower in Mt. Gelmir, in the Altus Plateau region.

name: Pulley Crossbow
where: The Pulley Crossbow is looted from a corpse next to the Craftsman's Shack Site of Grace in Mt. Gelmir.

name: Rapier
where: To get the standard Rapier in Elden Ring, you can simply purchase it for 1,000 Runes from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold.

name: Raptor Talons
where: To get the Raptor Talons in Elden Ring, travel to Sage's Cave in the Altus Plateau.

name: Red Branch Shortbow
where: To get the Red Branch Shortbow in Elden Ring, you need to farm and defeat Page enemies (the hooded human enemies) until it drops, with reliable spots at Tombsward Ruins in the Weeping Peninsula, Caria Manor in Liurnia, or the East Capital Rampart in Leyndell.

name: Reduvia
where: Drop from Bloody Finger Nerijus (invader)

name: Regalia of Eochaid
where: To get the Regalia of Eochaid, an Arcane-scaling straight sword, head to the secluded beach plateau in East Limgrave.

name: Ringed Finger
where: The Ringed Finger is a quirky, club-like weapon found inside Gelmir Hero's Grave in Mt. Gelmir.

name: Ripple Blade
where: The Ripple Blade in Elden Ring can be purchased for 3,500 runes from Pidia, Carian Servant at Caria Manor in northern Liurnia of the Lakes.

name: Ripple Crescent Halberd
where: To get the Ripple Crescent Halberd in Elden Ring, you must farm second-generation Albinaurics who wield the weapon in Liurnia of the Lakes, specifically around the Academy Gate Town or the Fallen Ruins of the Lake.

name: Rivers of Blood
where: Drop from Bloody Finger Okina (invader)

name: Rogier's Rapier
where: To get Rogier's Rapier, first speak to Sorcerer Rogier in the chapel at Stormveil Castle.

name: Rosus' Axe
where: To get Rosus' Axe, travel to the Black Knife Catacombs in northeast Liurnia of the Lakes, use a Stonesword Key on the imp statue fog door near the entrance, and loot the weapon inside the room.

name: Rotten Battle Hammer
where: To get the Rotten Battle Hammer in Elden Ring, you must travel to the Concerated Snowfield and defeat the Rotten Duelist boss.

name: Rotten Crystal Spear
where: The Rotten Crystal Spear is obtained as a random drop from lesser Crystalian enemies in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree, specifically near the Elphael Inner Wall site of grace.

name: Rotten Crystal Staff
where: To get the Rotten Crystal Staff, you must farm the Lesser Crystalian mage located in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree.

name: Rotten Crystal Sword
where: To get the Rotten Crystal Sword in Elden Ring, travel to Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree, locate the chest guarded by three Crystalian enemies near the Elphael Inner Wall site of grace, and loot it.

name: Rotten Greataxe
where: To get the Rotten Greataxe in Elden Ring, travel to the Consecrated Snowfield, locate the Rotten Duelist northwest of Ordina, Liturgical Town, and defeat him.

name: Rotten Staff
where: To get the Rotten Staff in Elden Ring, you must defeat the Putrid Avatar boss located in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree.

name: Royal Greatsword
where: To get the Royal Greatsword, you must complete the extensive questline for Ranni the Witch.

name: Ruins Greatsword
where: Drop from Misbegotten Warrior & Crucible Knight duo

name: Rusted Anchor
where: To get the Rusted Anchor in Elden Ring, travel to the Morne Tunnel in the Weeping Peninsula.

name: Sacred Relic Sword
where: Elden Remembrance (Elden Beast)

name: Sacrificial Axe
where: To get the Sacrificial Axe in Elden Ring, you must defeat the Deathbird boss located in the Weeping Peninsula at nighttime.

name: Scavenger's Curved Sword
where: To get the Scavenger's Curved Sword in Elden Ring, head to the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite in Mt. Gelmir.

name: Scepter of the All-Knowing
where: You can get the Scepter of the All-Knowing by defeating Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing in Leyndell, Ashen Capital.

name: Scimitar
where: You can get the Scimitar in Elden Ring by purchasing it from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 600 runes, choosing the Warrior starting class, or farming it from skeleton enemies.

name: Scorpion's Stinger
where: To get the Scorpion's Stinger dagger, head to the Grand Cloister in the Lake of Rot.

name: Scythe
where: To get the standard Scythe in Elden Ring, head to the Cliffbottom Catacombs in the southeastern region of Liurnia of the Lakes.

name: Sentry's Torch
where: To get the Sentry's Torch in Elden Ring, purchase it from the Hermit Merchant in the Altus Plateau for 7,000 Runes.

name: Serpent Bow
where: Serpent Bow can be found by a pool of rot in Abandoned Cave

name: Serpent-God's Curved Sword
where: To get the Serpent-God's Curved Sword in Elden Ring, travel to the Ruin-Strewn Precipice dungeon in northern Liurnia of the Lakes, navigate up the chasm past the ladders and lifts, and find it on an outdoor ledge guarded by a large Land Octopus.

name: Serpent-Hunter
where: To get the Serpent-Hunter, travel to the Audience Pathway Site of Grace in Volcano Manor (Mt. Gelmir).

name: Serpentbone Blade
where: To get the Serpentbone Blade, complete the second assassination contract given by Tanith at Volcano Manor in the Altus Plateau.

name: Shamshir
where: To get the Shamshir in Elden Ring, travel to the Saintsbridge site of grace in Limgrave, use the spirit spring to drop into the ravine, and find it on a corpse guarded by bats at the bottom of Highroad Cave.

name: Short Spear
where: You can get the Short Spear in Elden Ring by purchasing it from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 600 runes, choosing the Prophet starting class, or farming it from foot soldiers.

name: Short Sword
where: To get the Short Sword in Elden Ring, buy it from the Nomadic Merchant in North Limgrave for 600 Runes, start as the Astrologer class, or farm it from Highwaymen.

name: Shortbow
where: You can buy the standard Shortbow from the Nomadic Merchant on the West Limgrave beach for 600 Runes, or start the game as the Bandit class.

name: Shotel
where: To get the standard Shotel, buy it from the abandoned nomadic merchant near the Worshipper's Woods site of grace in Siofra River Well for 2,500 runes.

name: Siluria's Tree
where: To get Siluria's Tree in Elden Ring, you must travel to the Deeproot Depths Wiki region, reach the Nameless Eternal City Site of Grace, and defeat the Crucible Knight Siluria boss.

name: Soldier's Crossbow
where: The Soldier's Crossbow is a random drop obtained by defeating specific foot soldiers and exile soldiers who wield it.

name: Spear
where: To get a basic Spear in Elden Ring early on, you can either buy a Shortspear from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 600 runes, or farm one from the Exile Soldiers in Stormveil Castle.

name: Spiked Caestus
where: Get the Spiked Caestus at the Isolated Merchant Shack in northern Caelid.

name: Spiked Club
where: The Spiked Club in Elden Ring is acquired by farming large, chief-type Demi-Humans who wield the weapon, featuring a 2% base drop rate.

name: Spiked Spear
where: The Spiked Spear in Elden Ring is farmed by defeating Marionette Soldiers who wield spears near the Converted Tower in Liurnia of the Lakes.

name: St. Trina's Torch
where: To get St. Trina's Torch in Elden Ring, you must travel to a guarded carriage caravan in the Consecrated Snowfield.

name: Staff of Loss
where: To get the Staff of Loss, travel to Sellia, Town of Sorcery in northeastern Caelid.

name: Staff of the Avatar
where: To get the Staff of the Avatar in Elden Ring, travel to the Deeproot Depths, find the Great Waterfall Crest Site of Grace, and defeat the Erdtree Avatar nearby.

name: Staff of the Guilty
where: To get the Staff of the Guilty in Elden Ring, you must farm Thorn Sorcerers who wield blazing red staves at locations like Fort Laiedd or Guardian's Garrison, as it is a rare random drop.

name: Star Fist
where: To get the Star Fist in Elden Ring, travel to the West Capital Rampart Site of Grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

name: Starscourge Greatsword
where: Remembrance of the Starscourge (Starscourge Radahn)

name: Steel-Wire Torch
where: The Steel-Wire Torch in Elden Ring is found on a corpse along the ramparts of Castle Morne on the Weeping Peninsula.

name: Stone Club
where: The Stone Club is a rare weapon in Elden Ring that drops from Battlemage enemies.

name: Stormhawk Axe
where: The Stormhawk Axe can be obtained in two main ways: by defeating the NPC Nepheli Loux, or by looting it from specific locations in the Royal Capital or Mountaintops of the Giants.

name: Sword of Milos
where: To get the Sword of Milos, you must defeat the Dung Eater.

name: Sword of Night and Flame
where: Found in a chest

name: Sword of St. Trina
where: To get the original Sword of St. Trina in the base game, travel to the Rotview Balcony Site of Grace in Caelid, head down to the Forsaken Ruins while avoiding the giant crows, use a Stonesword Key on the imp statue basement seal, and open the chest inside.

name: Thorned Whip
where: The Thorned Whip is a rare drop from a specific Fire Prelate located in the Mountaintops of the Giants region.

name: Torch
where: The easiest way to get a torch in Elden Ring is to purchase the standard Torch for 200 Runes from Merchant Kalé at the Church of Elleh in West Limgrave.

name: Torchpole
where: To get the Torchpole in Elden Ring, you must farm the Exiled Soldiers who carry torch poles in Stormveil Castle.

name: Treespear
where: The Treespear is located in a chest on the back of an abandoned carriage in southeastern Liurnia of the Lakes, just south of a broken bridge.

name: Troll Knight's Sword
where: To get the Troll Knight's Sword in Elden Ring, you can get a guaranteed drop from Caria Manor or farm spectral troll knights in Liurnia of the Lakes.

name: Troll's Golden Sword
where: To get the Troll's Golden Sword in Elden Ring, travel to the Altus Plateau, locate the enemy camp east of the Erdtree-Gazing Hill site of grace, and open the chest on the back of the carriage.

name: Troll's Hammer
where: To get the Troll's Hammer in Elden Ring, you need 2 Stonesword Keys and must travel to the Old Altus Tunnel in the Altus Plateau.

name: Twinblade
where: Head east from the Agheel Lake South or The First Step Site of Grace to the Dragon-Burnt Ruins in Limgrave.

name: Twinned Knight Swords
where: To get the Twinned Knight Swords in Elden Ring, head to East Windmill Pasture in the Altus Plateau, loot the corpse by the burning pile, and watch out for exploding enemies.

name: Uchigatana
where: To get the Uchigatana in Elden Ring, you can either start the game by choosing the Samurai class, or find it on a corpse inside the Deathtouched Catacombs in northern Limgrave.

name: Urumi
where: To get the Urumi whip in Elden Ring, head to Caria Manor in northwestern Liurnia of the Lakes.

name: Varre's Bouquet
where: To get Varré's Bouquet in Elden Ring, complete White Mask Varré's questline, travel to Mohgwyn Palace using the Pureblood Knight's Medal, find his red invasion sign near the Dynasty Mausoleum Midpoint Site of Grace, defeat him in his world, and exhaust his dying dialogue.

name: Venomous Fang
where: The Venomous Fang, a fist/claw weapon known for its unique "deadly poison" effect, is found in the Abandoned Cave in Caelid.

name: Veteran's Prosthesis
where: To get the Veteran's Prosthesis in Elden Ring, you must travel to Castle Sol, locate the boss arena, and defeat the boss, Commander Niall.

name: Vulgar Militia Saw
where: To get the Vulgar Militia Saw in Elden Ring, travel to the Bestial Sanctum or Farum Great Bridge Site of Grace in northern Caelid, and repeatedly defeat the nearby Vulgar Militiamen wielding this weapon until it drops.

name: Vulgar Militia Shotel
where: To get the Vulgar Militia Shotel in Elden Ring, you must farm and defeat the Vulgar Militiamen enemies who wield this specific weapon.

name: Vyke's War Spear
where: Drop from Festering Fingerprint Vyke (invader)

name: Wakizashi
where: The Wakizashi is hidden inside Gaol Cave in southwestern Caelid.

name: Warhawk's Talon
where: To get the Warhawk's Talon straight sword in Elden Ring, you must farm the Bladed Talon Eagle (Warhawk) enemies located inside Stormveil Castle.

name: Warped Axe
where: The Warped Axe is a rare 4% drop from axe-wielding Omen enemies.

name: Warpick
where: The Warpick in Elden Ring is a random drop obtained by defeating specific soldier enemies who wield the weapon, such as those near the Gatefront Ruins or Agheel Lake South in Limgrave.

name: Watchdog's Greatsword
where: To get the Watchdog's Greatsword in Elden Ring, you must farm sword-wielding Erdtree Burial Watchdogs located in late-game dungeons like the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave or the Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs.

name: Watchdog's Staff
where: To get the Watchdog's Staff in Elden Ring, travel to the Road's End Catacombs in Liurnia of the Lakes, head down two flights of stairs from the site of grace, and strike the illusory back wall.

name: Weathered Straight Sword
where: To get the Weathered Straight Sword in Elden Ring, you must farm Commoner enemies at Stormveil Castle or the Ailing Village until it drops.

name: Whip
where: The standard base Whip is the easiest to find early on.

name: Wing of Astel
where: The Wing of Astel is found in a chest atop a ruined structure in the Uhl Palace Ruins, located in the Ainsel River underground area.

name: Winged Greathorn
where: Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor (Regal Ancestor Spirit)

name: Winged Scythe
where: To get the Winged Scythe, travel to the Tombsword Ruins in the Weeping Peninsula (south of Limgrave).

name: Zamor Curved Sword
where: To get the Zamor Curved Sword in Elden Ring, find and defeat the boss at the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave dungeon.

name: Zweihander
where: The Zweihander is a Colossal Sword that can be purchased early in the game for 3,500 Runes from the Isolated Merchant located on the western coast of the Weeping Peninsula.
